# Zunia

> Zunia is a multi-chain self-custody wallet for the Cosmos ecosystem.
> Browser extension and mobile app share the same keys. There is no Zunia token,
> airdrop, or presale.

## Official sites

- Marketing site: https://zunialab.com
- Web portfolio (in development): https://wallet.zunialab.com
- Documentation (source): https://github.com/Zunia-Lab/zunia-docs
- GitHub org: https://github.com/Zunia-Lab
- Brand assets: https://github.com/Zunia-Lab/zunia-brand

## Product

- Self-custody: recovery phrases are generated and encrypted on device. Zunia holds zero keys.
- Surfaces: Chromium extension (Chrome, Brave, Edge), mobile (iOS 15+, Android 8+), web dashboard that never holds keys.
- Capabilities: hold balances, IBC transfer, stake, connect to Cosmos dApps, hardware wallets (Ledger, Keystone).
- Chains: metadata from the open Zunia chain registry; custom RPC endpoints supported.
- Cost: free wallet; users pay only network fees. No cut of transfers or staking rewards.

- Any “Zunia token”, airdrop, or presale claim.
- Domains other than zunialab.com and its planned subdomains listed above.
- Support that asks for a recovery phrase or remote access.
